title: Our 2026 novelties
titleHtml:
Our 2026
novelties

slides.title: Neo Frame Jumping Hour
slides.alt: Close up of the Neo Frame Jumping Hour watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Offshore Diver
slides.desc: This sporty 42 mm reference pairs a deep teal dial with pink gold accents, showcasing the collection’s commitment to creative expression and technical performance.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak Offshore watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Offshore Selfwinding Chronograph
slides.desc: This 37 mm titanium Royal Oak Offshore, framed by a diamond‑set bezel, is powered by Calibre 6401, the Manufacture’s latest integrated selfwinding chronograph movement, blending sporty codes with a refined pink aesthetic.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak Offshore watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Offshore Selfwinding Chronograph
slides.desc: Presented in stainless steel, this sporty wristwatch brings a vibrant edge to the collection's powerful design through energetic orange accents.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak Offshore watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Concept Flying Tourbillon
slides.desc: Created in collaboration with Yoon and Verbal, this Royal Oak Concept Flying Tourbillon brings bold minimalism into a compact 38.5 mm titanium case.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak Concept watch.

slides.title: Établisseurs Galets
slides.desc: A sculptural timepiece inspired by the water-polished stones of the Vallée de Joux, shaped around the hand‑finished Calibre 3098.
slides.alt: Close-up of an Établisseurs watch.

slides.title: 150 Heritage Ultra-complication Universal Calendar
slides.alt: Close up of the 150 Heritage watch.

slides.title: Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet Selfwinding Flying Tourbillon
slides.desc: Showcasing an ethereal flying tourbillon, this complication combines technical sophistication with contemporary contrast.
slides.alt: Close up of a Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Selfwinding Perpetual Calendar
slides.desc: Combining refined aesthetics with technical mastery, this 41 mm Perpetual Calendar is crafted entirely in “Bleu Nuit, Nuage 50” ceramic and powered by Calibre 7138.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Selfwinding Chronograph
slides.desc: Adorned with brilliant-cut diamonds, the bezel of this 38 mm Chronograph adds a dazzling accent to a technical milestone, the new Calibre 6401.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Mini Quartz
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak watch.

slides.title: Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet Selfwinding Perpetual Calendar Openworked
slides.alt: Close up of a Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Selfwinding Perpetual Calendar Openworked
slides.desc: Calibre 7139 takes centre stage in this openworked reference combining ergonomic innovation with a striking blend of titanium and Bulk Metallic Glass.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Selfwinding
slides.desc: Blending the radiance of yellow gold with the unique beauty of natural malachite, this model celebrates the artistry of stone dials - making each watch a singular expression of elegance and craftsmanship.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak Offshore Selfwinding Chronograph
slides.desc: Blending cutting-edge technology with fine watchmaking, this 43 mm Chronograph features a deep blue “Bleu Nuit, Nuage 50” ceramic case and a beige Méga Tapisserie dial, extending the Offshore line with vibrant contrasts and innovative materials.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak Offshore watch.

slides.title: Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet Selfwinding
slides.desc: Embracing intense dark tones, this model pairs a black embossed dial with a matching alligator strap, creating an elegant and timeless allure.
slides.alt: Close up of a Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet watch.

slides.title: Royal Oak "Jumbo" Extra-Thin Openworked
slides.desc: Presented in titanium with BMG accents, the original “Jumbo” model features a refined monochromatic design enhanced by intricate openworking, offering a captivating view of Calibre 7124.
slides.alt: Close up of a Royal Oak watch.
